title: 404: NO WAY OUT
premise: Darius Cole returns to Veyron City after his brother disappears. What begins as a missing-person investigation expands into a criminal organization, corrupt businesses, government connections, secret operations, and the meaning of 404.

protagonists.Darius: Calm, intelligent, observant, ambitious. Best for investigation and balanced play.
protagonists.Malik: Loud, funny, reckless, loyal. Best for vehicles, mechanics, strength and high-risk approaches.
protagonists.Amara: Intelligent, controlled, sarcastic, mysterious. Best for stealth, analysis, social manipulation and information.

phases.name: Darius & Core Gameplay
phases.focus: Player, movement, camera/gameplay foundation and progression hooks.

phases.name: Veyron City & Living World
phases.focus: Veyron Central, East Veyron, West Coast, North Hills, Iron District, airport, port and island; day/night, weather, traffic, interiors and density.

phases.name: Living NPCs & Social Simulation
phases.focus: Identity, personality, mood, relationships, schedules, memory, context-based reactions, phones and witnesses.

phases.name: Vehicles, Traffic & Physical World
phases.focus: Cars, SUVs, trucks, motorcycles, boats, emergency/public transport, vehicle damage and tire reactions.

phases.name: Combat, Crime, Witnesses & Police
phases.focus: Melee, shooting, stealth, crime severity, witness visibility/recognition, dispatch and pursuit.

phases.name: Missions, Activities & Progression
phases.focus: Main missions, character missions, heists, chases, investigations, side activities and random events.

phases.name: Economy, Properties & Personal Life
phases.focus: Cash, bank, purchases, income, businesses, properties, phone/laptop, clothing, relationships and hobbies.

phases.name: 404 Story, Relationships & Cinematic Experience
phases.focus: Missing brother, criminal organization, corrupt businesses, government connections, secret operations, relationships and character switching.

phases.name: Endgame & Replay
phases.focus: Final operation, branching choices, protagonist-specific solutions, endings, post-game world and replay value.

ending_design: Truth Ending — expose the operation with the strongest evidence chain.
Family Ending — prioritize finding and protecting the missing brother.
Power Ending — take control of part of the network rather than destroying everything.
Shadow Ending — keep the truth buried and disappear, preserving the protagonists but leaving unanswered questions.

playtime.with_side_content: 40–55+ hours depending on exploration, activities, property/economy play and alternate approaches.
